purpose: Define the initial governed product universe before source collection, forecasting, ranking, or purchase authorization.

scope_basis.rule: Determine eligibility product by product from booster format and product configuration rather than using a fixed pre-2019 cutoff.
scope_basis.collector_option_exclusion: Exclude a booster-box product when that set or release has a Collector Booster option.
scope_basis.draft_booster_exclusion: Exclude all Draft Booster boxes, including products that coexisted with early Collector Booster products.

required_inclusion_conditions.damage_state: No damaged seals or materially damaged boxes

included_product_families_when_all_condi: other complete factory-sealed booster boxes that are not Collector, Draft, or Play Booster products

vintage_high_price_products.initial_treatment: Include when they otherwise satisfy the governed scope.
vintage_high_price_products.future_treatment: They may be excluded through a documented owner decision if their price, liquidity, scarcity, or evidence profile materially distorts the model or comparison universe.

identity_rules.language_dimension: English-only universe; foreign-language variants are excluded rather than separately governed.
identity_rules.authentication_dimension: Authentication is not required and authenticated versus unauthenticated boxes are not separate governed asset classes at this stage.
identity_rules.condition_dimension: Only intact, undamaged factory-sealed examples are eligible; damaged examples are excluded rather than modeled as separate classes.

governance_controls.next_required_stage: Build and certify the candidate product-universe inventory against this scope decision.
governance_controls.change_control: Any change to product formats, language, sealed-state rules, inclusion families, exclusion families, or identity treatment requires owner approval, a version change, and recertification.

owner_decision_notes: The category must not be defined solely as all products released before 2019.
The practical investment universe is complete sealed booster boxes without a Collector Booster option and excluding Draft and Play Booster products.
Supplemental products are acceptable when the governed asset is a full sealed booster box.
Expensive vintage products remain visible initially so evidence can determine whether they distort modeling; they are not presumed purchase candidates.
